_comment: World dressing, coordinator Meshy batch 31 Oct (tb/props-r2 31592e46, assets/props/meshy-1031, provenance.json in each folder). OFF until GPU judged. P2-115 (Tidewake 4.59): forward-camp creature bed reads as a flat oval curb with no bedding; P2-116 (4.71): camp workbench is a small unreadable bench behind the trainer. Visible meshes only (scripts/world/meshy_camp_props.gd): old meshes hidden, not freed, so colliders, rest body, build index and craft offers are unchanged. Scale: the bed keeps the 4.8 m rim span creatures larger than the 1.80 m trainer rest in; the bench's lantern post stands 2.3 m so it reads above the trainer in the camp views.

nest_candidate._why: Visual lane (3 Nov 2026), P2-115 / F39#12 (GPU WD2 5.23 on the Meshy ring: 'reads as a fire pit or well'; path 'a raised nest or cushion shape with bedding'). Blender-built raised woven nest (0.82 m rim crest, domed sailcloth cushion, teal blanket draped over the rim, driftwood lashings); provenance assets/props/vl-1103/nest_bed/provenance.json. Same 4.6 m span, same colliders and rest anchor. OFF until judged.
nest_candidate._why_on: ON (visual lane v1/b9, 3 Nov 2026): r2 nest F39#12 CPU 5.86 -> 7.02 mapped (three code-blind judges, linear slope 1.06, r 0.79, anchor RMSE 0.74, confirming batch; reads as a pet bed in all three camp views, defect FIXED 1 / PARTIAL 2).
nest_candidate._why_r2: r1 (nest_bed.glb) judged CPU v1/b6 (3 Nov; three judges, linear slope 0.82, r 0.59, RMSE 0.66): 5.39 -> 5.83, reads as bedding but near-white on pale sand. r2: golden straw, warm canvas, deeper teal and driftwood in linear-correct values; OFF until judged.

vl_candidate._why: Visual lane (3 Nov 2026), P2-116 / F39#13 (GPU WD2 6.08 on the Meshy bench; path 'a larger work surface with clear tools'). Blender-built 2.6 m plank bench with a 2.15 m tool board (hammer, saw, tongs, rope coil on pegs), vise, workpiece, mallet and a 2.6 m lantern post; provenance assets/props/vl-1103/camp_workbench/provenance.json. Same collider and craft offer. OFF until judged.
vl_candidate._why_on: ON (visual lane v1/b9, 3 Nov 2026): r2 bench F39#13 CPU 6.03 -> 6.56 mapped (three code-blind judges, linear slope 1.06, r 0.79, anchor RMSE 0.74, confirming batch; reads as a work station, defect PARTIAL 3/3: pale on sand and the trainer still covers it in view 1).
vl_candidate._why_r2b: Correctness fix (LANE-SCENE, 13 Nov 2026). camp_workbench_r2.glb turned each joined material group about its own origin, so the hung tools, rope coil, vise, jar and lantern sat up to 1.6 m off the bench (model 4.61 m long against a 2.6 m top; the floating dark squares and the stray white ring in the Tidewake camp frames) and the bounds-centred bench stood about 0.9 m off its craft prompt. r2b is the same build with every group turned about the bench centre (source/workbench_r2b.py); tests/test_camp_workbench_model_parts.gd pins it.
vl_candidate._why_r2: r1 (camp_workbench.glb) judged CPU v1/b6: 5.75 -> 5.36 (worse); the judges saw the tool board from behind ('an upright pale board like a notice board'). r2 is the same bench turned 180 deg so the tools face the camp camera; OFF until judged.

workbench._why_yaw: r2: the camp view stands at (+4, -5) from the bench and looks through the trainer; -39 deg turns the long axis across that view so the bench spans past the trainer.
